purpose: Machine-checks a digital trade presentation (digital LC, collection, or open-account transaction) against the ICC digital rulebooks: eUCP v2.1, eURC v1.1, URDTT v1.0. Produces a discrepancy list with article citations, severity ratings, and remediation actions.
